progress.title: Progress
progress.noMealsLogged: No meals logged in this period
progress.cannotRecalculateDesc: Log a weight entry and complete onboarding first.
progress.planUpdatedDesc: Your plan has been recalculated using your latest weight of {{weight}}.

streak_about_to_break.title: Don't lose your {{n}}-day streak
streak_about_to_break.message: Log a meal before midnight to keep it going.
streak_about_to_break.message_soft: A quick log keeps it going — even something small counts.
streak_about_to_break.message_bold: Log now or it resets at midnight.

streak_personal_best_chance.title: 1 day from your best streak ever
streak_personal_best_chance.title_bold: One log between you and a new personal best
streak_personal_best_chance.message: Best so far: {{best}} days. Log today to make it {{today}}.
streak_personal_best_chance.message_soft: You're {{best}} days deep. One more log and you set a new record.

streak_restart_opportunity.title: Pick the streak back up
streak_restart_opportunity.title_soft: Welcome back — let's start a new one
streak_restart_opportunity.message: Your last streak hit {{prior}} days. Log a meal today and start a new one.
streak_restart_opportunity.message_soft: Your last streak hit {{prior}} days — every comeback starts with one log.

calorie_surplus_3d.title: 3 days over your goal
calorie_surplus_3d.message: You've averaged {{over}} kcal over your daily target. Adjust today's plan to stay on track.
calorie_surplus_3d.message_soft: Three days over by ~{{over}} kcal. Today's a clean slate — small wins from here.

calorie_deficit_too_aggressive.title: You're under-eating — refuel
calorie_deficit_too_aggressive.message: Three days well below your target. Eating more in your range protects muscle and progress.
calorie_deficit_too_aggressive.message_soft: Going too low for too long stalls progress. Try eating closer to your plan today.

consistency_dropped.title: Consistency dropped this week
consistency_dropped.message: Log a meal today and the trend resets. The wins come from showing up, not perfection.
consistency_dropped.message_soft: Off weeks happen. One log today and you're already turning it around.

protein_chronic_low.title: Protein is limiting your progress
protein_chronic_low.message: You've been ~{{gap}}g below your {{target}}g target for 5 of 7 days. Add a protein source to today's meals.
protein_chronic_low.message_soft: You're about {{gap}}g shy of {{target}}g most days — small protein adds compound fast.

weight_log_stale.title: Step on the scale
weight_log_stale.message: {{days}} days since your last weight log. Logging weekly is what makes the trend honest.
weight_log_stale.message_soft: It's been {{days}} days. Even one weigh-in unlocks the next chapter of your trend.

near_goal.title: You're {{remaining}} lbs from your goal
near_goal.message: Stay locked in. The last stretch is the one most people quit before.
near_goal.message_soft: You're so close. Keep doing what's working.

streak_milestone.title: {{n}}-day streak
streak_milestone.message: You showed up {{n}} days in a row. That's the system working.
streak_milestone.message_soft: {{n}} days of logs — proud of you. Keep going.

best_week_ever.title: Best week of adherence yet
best_week_ever.message: You hit your calorie target on {{pct}}% of logged days this week. New high.
best_week_ever.message_soft: Your most on-target week yet. Anchor what worked.

on_pace_for_goal.title: Right on pace
on_pace_for_goal.message: Your weekly rate is matching your plan. The math is working.
on_pace_for_goal.message_soft: You're trending exactly where the plan expects. Keep going.

protein_optimization.title: Add ~{{gap}}g of protein
protein_optimization.message: You're close — averaging {{target}}g daily would lock in better composition.
protein_optimization.message_soft: You're trending well. A tiny protein bump would dial it in.

weekend_drift.title: Your weekends drift
weekend_drift.message: Weekends average {{pct}}% over your weekday baseline. Plan Friday's meals first.
weekend_drift.message_soft: Weekends slip a bit — picking Friday's meals on Thursday usually fixes it.

late_log_pattern.title: Try logging meals as you eat
late_log_pattern.message: You've been logging mostly after 8pm. Logging in real time keeps the data honest.
late_log_pattern.message_soft: Logging in the moment is way more accurate than logging from memory.

no_data.title: Log your first meal
no_data.title_soft: Welcome — let's get your first log in
no_data.message: One meal unlocks your dashboard, your streak, and your trend.
no_data.message_soft: Log anything — coffee, a snack — and the dashboard lights up.

neutral_steady.title: Steady so far
neutral_steady.message: Stay consistent and let the trend lead the way.
neutral_steady.message_soft: Keep doing what you're doing — the data will catch up.

progress.bmiNeedsHeight: Add height in profile to see BMI.
progress.ffmiNeedsProfile: Add height and current weight in your profile to calculate FFMI.
progress.ffmiEnterBodyFat: Enter your estimated body fat to see FFMI (uses profile weight and height).
progress.emptyWeightSubtitle: Log your first weight to unlock trend charts.
progress.emptyMealsSubtitle: Log meals to see calories & macros over time.
